findings.title: The announcement above the headline looks like a link and crowds the headline

location.description: The small underlined line Easelroom now books model sessions too, directly above the main headline.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer takes the line for a text link or a caption, and it sits so close above the headline that it reads as part of it, so the news is easy to miss or to misread.

current.value: A line of small underlined text sits about ten pixels above the headline and is styled like the page's other links.

findings.target: The announcement reads as a separate note that is set apart from the headline, and it is not mistaken for an ordinary link.
findings.fix_direction: Make the announcement read as its own item, apart from the headline, and stop it looking like a link unless it is one.
findings.source: Nielsen Norman Group, link and visual affordance guidance

closed_when.check: Look above the headline and check that the announcement reads as a separate note and does not look like a text link.
